title: Nager.Date public holidays API (Italy national holidays, by year)
summary: Nager.Date REST endpoint returning national public holidays for a given year and ISO country code. For UC2 it would be queried as country=IT for each year, giving one record per holiday date (date, local and English name, global flag, counties, types). It is a calendar lookup of holiday dates, with no daily measurements; it covers national holidays only and was probed successfully for 2023, 2024 and 2026; 2025 was not probed.

fields.name: fixed
fields.description: Whether the date is fixed each year

fields.name: counties
fields.description: Sub-national region codes; null in probed responses

fields.name: launchYear
fields.description: Year the holiday was introduced; null in probed responses

schema.notes: Field list taken from the response shape returned by call_public_api for 2023, 2024 and 2026 (IT). Descriptions are inferred from field names and values except where noted; no API schema document was read.

spatial.notes: Country-level only. Probed responses contain only global=true national holidays with counties=null; regional and patron-saint days of northern Italy are not returned.

ownership.publisher: Nager.Date project (GitHub nager/Nager.Date; hosted service date.nager.at)

licence.evidence: Register entry api.nager_public_holidays: agreement_status not_required_open_data, approved_purposes prototyping and production, terms_url https://github.com/nager/Nager.Date. probe_url of that page shows 'MIT license' for the repository code and a LICENSE file link; no statement on the licence of the holiday data served by the API was found. The MIT licence appears to cover the software, not necessarily the data.

access.request_process: Plain GET https://date.nager.at/api/v3/PublicHolidays/{year}/IT, no key. One call per year.

documentation_excerpts: country is ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (PT, GB, FR, ...). (register param_notes, api.nager_public_holidays)
Easily access public holidays for 200+ countries via .NET, REST API, Docker, or NuGet for online and offline use. (probe_url github repo)
MIT license (probe_url github repo, repository licence label)
quality_notes: Probe 2024 (IT): HTTP 200, 13 holidays, min 2024-01-01, max 2024-12-26. Probe 2023 (IT): HTTP 200, 13 holidays, min 2023-01-01, max 2023-12-26. Probe 2026 (IT): HTTP 200, 14 holidays, min 2026-01-01, max 2026-12-26.
2025 was not probed, so the 2025 coverage needed for the recent window (2025-06-01 to 2026-03-31) and the history window end (2025-05-31) is unverified.

Coverage is national only: all probed records have global=true and counties=null. Northern-Italy regional or patron-saint days (for example local feast days in the Valdena area) are not returned and must be sourced separately.
Bridge days (ponte) are not represented; the API lists calendar holidays only.

Easter Sunday is included as a 'Public' holiday type in the responses, which is a classification choice: it is not a working-day holiday. Users must decide whether to keep it as a holiday flag. Easter Monday presence should be checked in the 2025 probe.
Holidays falling on weekends are returned with their dates and will confound a weekday effect unless the analysis handles them.

Source is a third-party community project; the register terms_url points to the GitHub repository, not a dedicated data licence. The API and its data are served from nagerholidays.com/date.nager.at, which the register does not list separately.
Responses appear cached (from_cache true on probes); freshness of the calendar and update cadence are unknown.
